task_completion.description: Save the workflow and ensure it appears as 'Active' in the list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final workflow list view showing the new rule 'Auto-Update Next Step on Closed Won' with a status toggle or icon indicating it is 'Active'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The workflow must be created for the 'Potentials' module. The exact name is 'Auto-Update Next Step on Closed Won'. The trigger condition is 'Sales Stage' (internal field: sales_stage) equals 'Closed Won'. The action is an 'Update Fields' (UpdateFields) task titled 'Set Next Step to Generate Invoice' which modifies the 'Next Step' (internal field: nextstep) to the value 'Generate Invoice'.
